intent: Assess a synthetic table for training a binary subscription-renewal classifier.
description: The user confirms renewed as the target. Monthly usage, tenure, and plan type are the only candidate features. No customer rows are included.

intent: Check outcome-label balance and demographic representation before training on a synthetic table.
description: The user confirms label as the target, but has not identified the demographic attribute. Region and segment have ambiguous meanings and neither has been confirmed for group comparisons.

intent: Check for gaps in daily readings from synthetic equipment data.
description: Readings should arrive once per day. The user confirms read_at as the timestamp. This is a daily series, not an hourly one.

intent: Only validate the file references in a synthetic scan manifest. Do not inspect the images or run other quality checks.
description: The user confirms scan_file as the only path column. Relative references use the manifest directory on the execution host. No files or image pixels are sent to the planner.
